collection.description: Two Heathens have been arguing for a week about moving the camp's fire pit.

description_variants.description: Two Isolans have been arguing for a week about moving the camp's fire pit.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) wants to move the camp's fire pit closer to the stream. (friend) says it has been in the same place for longer than either of them has been alive. They have been arguing about this for a week.

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: Everyone gets a say. It takes all evening. The fire pit stays where it is, by a very small margin. (subject) takes it well. Mostly. \(no effect\)

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: They build a second, smaller fire by the stream, and keep both for a month. In the end people use both. Nobody admits to having been wrong, and nobody needs to.
